title: The Kids page is TMDB discovery, limited to what we hold
summary: Kids becomes a discovery page for a four-year-old: TMDB kids rows filtered to titles the servers hold via a weekly index, a kids Continue watching, New and coming for trailers, and yellow to get there.

rows.text: Family genre: Apollo Movies 8,818 of 95,825; Kids libraries: Apollo TV 2,315, Maverick Movies 1,161, TV 378. ~14k ids, ~30 requests of 500.
Companies Disney 2, Disney Animation 6125, Pixar 3, DreamWorks Animation 521; providers Netflix 8, Prime 9, Disney+ 337; genres Animation 16, Family 10751, Kids 10762 (TV).

brief.direction: Replace the certificate-filtered Kids mode with Discovery's machinery over a Kids list of TMDB rows, filtered locally against a weekly index of held kids/family titles; New and coming stays unfiltered for trailers.

points.q: Should 052's index take Animation and Children/Kids genres as well as Family outside the Kids libraries, so held kids titles tagged otherwise are not hidden?
points.evidence: 051 Animated row asks genre 16; kids TV asks 10762; 052 indexes Family only. Measured: Apollo Movies Animation 4,869, Children 237; Apollo TV Animation 722, Children 250.
points.if: 052 step 2 reads Family, Animation, Children and Kids genre keys; ~45 requests weekly instead of ~30
points.answer: Orchestrator recommendation taken: Family, Animation and Children genres (~45 requests weekly).

points.q: Should 053 delete the certificate path it leaves dead (isKidsRating, KIDS_MAX_AGE, contentRatings, the mock endpoint, its test)?
points.evidence: src/rules/ratings.ts:23,37; src/api/plex/library.ts:84; dev/mock-plex.js:698; dev/library.js:1016; test/rating.test.ts:50 — only caller browse.ts:25,1067
points.if: add those files to 053 and a delete step; ageLimit stays
points.answer: Orchestrator recommendation taken: 053 deletes the dead certificate path.

points.q: No age cap at all, or cap the film rows at a certificate (e.g. GB PG) given a four-year-old?
points.evidence: Real people and 90s Classics rows are Family films by popularity/votes with no cap; TMDB discover takes certification_country + certification.lte
points.if: add certification params to 051's film rows
points.answer: Stuart, 2026-11-09: "Yes allow pg but only from the tmdb kids list" — film rows capped at GB PG; New and coming exempt (unreleased films lack a certificate).
